title: Crime
descriptionFa: انواع جرم و مجرم، پلیس و دادگاه، و مشکلات دیگه‌ی شهری.

words.example: There is very little crime in our village.
Someone tried to steal my bike.
words.tipFa: چیز رو steal می‌کنیم: steal / stole / stolen. Somebody stole my bike، نه robbed my bike.

words.example: Two men tried to rob a bank in the city centre.
words.tipFa: آدم یا جا رو rob می‌کنیم: I was robbed، نه I was stolen.

words.example: A thief took my wallet on the bus.
words.tipFa: جمع: thieves. دزد ماشین: car thief.

words.example: The robber wore a mask and carried a gun.
A burglar came in through the kitchen window.

words.meaningFa: به زور وارد (خانه یا ماشین) شدن
words.example: Someone tried to break into our car last night.
The mugger took her handbag and ran away.
words.tipFa: خود جرم: mugging. فعلش: mug someone.

words.example: The guard caught a shoplifter with three phones in his coat.
The police are looking into a murder in the north of the city.
The police caught a drug dealer near the school.
words.tipFa: drug هم «دارو» معنی می‌ده و هم «مواد مخدر».

words.example: The police found the terrorist before he could hurt anyone.
A vandal wrote all over the walls of the school.
The police stopped a football hooligan from fighting outside the stadium.
It's against the law to drive without a licence.
Call the police!
words.tipFa: فعلش جمعه: The police are coming.

words.example: The police can arrest you for driving too fast.
words.tipFa: دستگیر شدن به خاطر چیزی: be arrested for something.

words.example: He has to go to court next month.
The court decided that he was guilty.
The man was innocent, so the judge let him go home.
If you drive through a red light, you'll get a big fine.
words.tipFa: pay a fine. fine صفت هم هست یعنی «خوب».

words.example: He spent five years in prison.
words.tipFa: بدون the: go to prison, be in prison.
